title: Kicky Crunchy Ukrainian Mushroom Dumplings
description: A funky and comforting Ukrainian dish featuring gelatine leafs and deglaze-fond, made plant-based-friendly with mushroom and vegetable ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Button or cremini mushrooms work well

ingredients.name: gelatine leafs
ingredients.notes: Vegan gelatine substitute can be used

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, gelatine leafs, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the vegetable oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball into a disk shape.
In a large pan, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the vegetable broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
To assemble the dumplings, place a spoonful of the mushroom mixture in the center of each dough disk and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with some oil and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Bake the dumplings in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
